verdict.rationale: Transport fallback is a fair axis for a real-time audio/video SDK, so the story applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions TCP, TLS, WebSocket, or TURN fallback when UDP is blocked, nor when such fallback would engage. The bandwidth-based lower-bitrate subscription is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, a stream survives a network that blocks UDP: the service documents fallback over TCP, TLS, or WebSocket and when it engages
